svg.title: HostTCD RX host DMA buffer layout

g.text: One parent → one buffer per logical destination
Default channel map: destinations 0–3 → channels A–D
Each A[k], B[k], C[k] or D[k] is one complex I/Q sample. N = samples per channel.
Sample k: byte offset 4 × k (IQ16) or 3 × k (IQ12). No headers or padding.
Timestamp record FIFO — separate from sample buffers
One timestamp record describes all channel buffers of a parent.
